# W13-0 clock lies — input for W13-3A

> **Dated pre-ledger evidence snapshot.** This fixture preserves measurements
> and expected claims from the 2026-08-12 W13 anatomy. References to
> `progressive_seal.rs` are historical and superseded; that deleted file is not
> a current implementation map. Every measured row below remains unchanged.

Measured or structurally proven on `fix/the-tail-patches@2e270b0f`.
No production change in this cut. W13-3A consumes this list item-by-item.

Canonical time (Amendment 3): integer sample ranges
`(session, capture_epoch, sample_start, sample_end)`. Seconds only at adapters.

## Histogram surfaces this cut owns

- Apple word-span duration / overlap / restart — collected by `tests/replay_take.rs` when the SFSpeech bridge is present (`histogram_apple_word_spans`).
- SFSpeech-span vs PCM divergence — lie #6, already measured at ~2 ms; ingestion map is W13-3A.
- Whisper timebase pre/post `extract_speech` — `tests/w13_clock_falsification.rs` (`compaction_timebase`).
- Digital-zero silence in both mic modes of take 191351 — same test (`digital_zero_regions`).
